summary_en: Toyo Tire raised its FY2026 year-end dividend forecast by 18 yen to 88 yen per share, from 70 yen, following completion of a share buyback program that reduced outstanding shares.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Toyo Tire announced a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending December 2026. The year-end dividend per share has been increased by 18 yen to 88 yen, up from the previous forecast of 70 yen announced on February 13, 2026. The interim dividend remains unchanged at 65 yen, resulting in a total annual dividend of 153 yen per share.

The increase was prompted by the completion of the company's share buyback program through off-market trading (ToSTNeT-3) announced on August 10, 2026. As the buyback reduced the number of outstanding shares (calculated by subtracting treasury shares from total issued shares), the company determined it could raise the year-end dividend while maintaining financial soundness and a stable dividend policy.

The company emphasized its commitment to stable dividends for shareholders while preserving financial health. The year-end dividend is subject to approval by the ordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for March 2027.
